target.title: feat: publish integrations and Crabbox Agent Skill discovery
target.body:
## Summary

- publish the generic Crabbox Agent Skill at `skills/crabbox/SKILL.md`, keep the repo-discoverable `.agents/skills/crabbox/SKILL.md` byte-identical, and reject drift in the docs gate
- make Skill metadata activate when `crabbox.yaml`, `.crabbox.yaml`, or the `crabbox` CLI is detected, while retaining remote-compute and evidence triggers
- make `crabbox init --skill` repeatable for repositories that need shared and host-native discovery paths; validate local `crabbox/SKILL.md` destinations and preflight every target before writing
- publish digest-verified domain discovery from crabbox.sh using the Agent Skills discovery draft plus a cross-vendor AI Catalog / ARD manifest, HTML discovery link, and `Agentmap`
- document audited discovery behavior across agent clients and ecosystem installers instead of adding duplicate per-vendor Skill implementations or an MCP/plugin loader
- correct the Zed package to recognize `crabbox.yaml` and `.crabbox.yaml` (not unsupported `.crabbox.yml`), and document exact Zed and Herdr publication status

## Why

The generated Skill originally omitted required `name` and `description` frontmatter. The checked-in Skill also lived only under hidden `.agents`, which many clients discover directly but GitHub CLI excludes from normal Skill source discovery. Other clients use native roots such as `.claude/skills`, `.kiro/skills`, or `.cline/skills`.

This change establishes one generic implementation with several transport layers:

1. automatic in-repository discovery through `.agents/skills`
2. installer discovery through the non-hidden `skills/*/SKILL.md` convention
3. host-native copies generated explicitly with repeatable `--skill`
4. domain discovery through crabbox.sh
5. task-time discovery through an AI Catalog

The Skill remains a thin, reviewable instruction layer over the installed CLI. It does not load executable plugins, forward model credentials, bypass host approval, or add an MCP server.

## Ecosystem coverage

| Route | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| `.agents/skills` | Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot / VS Code, Windsurf, Devin, Zed Agent, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, OpenCode, Roo, Amp, Warp, OpenHands, Letta, Mistral Vibe, and Goose via Summon |
| Native project roots | Claude Code, Junie, Kiro, Qwen Code, Factory Droid, and Cline through repeatable `crabbox init --skill` |
| GitHub CLI | `gh skill install openclaw/crabbox skills/crabbox --pin refs/heads/main --agent codex --scope project` |
| Skills CLI | `npx skills add https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox --skill crabbox` |
| Agent Skills domain discovery | `https://crabbox.sh/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` with a SHA-256 digest over the published bytes |
| Cross-vendor resource discovery | `https://crabbox.sh/.well-known/ai-catalog.json` using AI Catalog `specVersion: 1.0` and draft ARD discovery signals |

The client matrix links each host's current primary documentation and explicitly warns that the Agent Skills format does not mandate one search path. Vendor plugin manifests remain a follow-up for host marketplaces; they do not improve automatic repository discovery over the shared Skill and standard installers.

## Publication follow-ups

- Herdr direct installation works; topic-driven marketplace indexing is tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/1156.
- The Zed package is development-installable; the registry PR must pin a commit reachable from upstream after this merges and is tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/1157.
- GitHub CLI resolves the current v0.39.0 release before the default branch, so documentation selects `refs/heads/main` until v0.39.1 contains the generic source.
- The Agent Skills domain protocol and ARD are drafts. GitHub Pages serves conventional JSON/Markdown MIME types; strict AI Catalog media-type consumers may require a future header-capable edge.

## Validation

No new local test suite was run for the follow-up commit, per contributor request.

Static/source checks completed:

- `gofmt` on the changed Go files
- `git diff --check`
- byte comparison of the canonical Skill and its `.agents` projection
- independent source-only audits of CLI behavior, Windows path handling, docs fixtures, current client paths, GitHub CLI resolution, Agent Skills discovery v0.2.0, and AI Catalog / ARD schemas

Inspectible discovery proof gathered from the repository checkout:

```text
Agent Skills validator: Skill is valid!
Codex CLI 0.144.5: crabbox -> .agents/skills/crabbox/SKILL.md
Gemini CLI 0.37.1: crabbox [Enabled] -> .agents/skills/crabbox/SKILL.md
OpenCode 1.15.10: crabbox -> .agents/skills/crabbox/SKILL.md
```

Before the follow-up commit, the initial PR head also passed `go test ./internal/cli -count=1`, `scripts/check-docs.sh`, and all 17 hosted checks. Fresh hosted checks on the new head: 15/15 passed.

## Security

- detection is instructional and does not grant permission to start paid infrastructure
- the Skill tells agents to inspect repo config and run `crabbox doctor`
- credentials and lifecycle remain owned by Crabbox and the invoking host
- domain catalogs advertise the same reviewed Markdown artifact; they do not install or execute it

target.title: fix(auth): bind OAuth and sessions to immutable identity
target.body:
## Summary

Harden the two GitHub authentication identity boundaries:

- bind portal OAuth callbacks to the browser that initiated login
- bind signed sessions and durable ownership to GitHub's immutable numeric account ID

## Changes

- issue a short-lived `__Host-crabbox_oauth` cookie and retain only its SHA-256 hash
- validate the browser binding before exchanging the authorization code
- clear the binding after terminal portal outcomes
- use `github:<numeric-id>` as the authenticated owner identity
- re-fetch `/user` during membership revalidation and require its account ID to match the session owner
- reject legacy email-owned sessions instead of automatically transferring access to the current holder of that email
- preserve verified email checks and the existing CLI OAuth confirmation flow

## Compatibility

Existing GitHub sessions or durable records owned by an email fail closed for non-admin access and require explicit migration or recreation. No email-to-account ownership transfer is performed automatically.

Administrators should use immutable `github:<numeric-id>` values in `CRABBOX_GITHUB_ADMIN_OWNERS`; the existing login allowlist remains supported for compatibility.

## Validation

Added focused regression coverage for:

- missing or incorrect portal browser binding
- successful one-time callback and cookie cleanup
- callback replay
- immutable account ID revalidation
- account ID mismatch
- rejection of legacy email-owned sessions
- organization, team, and revocation checks

Full repository CI is pending on this draft PR.

target.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider
target.body:
## What

`provider: cloud-run-sandbox` — run commands in [Cloud Run sandboxes](https://docs.cloud.google.com/run/docs/code-execution) (preview).

| Mode | How |
| --- | --- |
| Remote | Gateway URL + secret → create/exec/delete |
| Direct | In-container `/usr/local/gcp/bin/sandbox` |

Not `provider: gcp` (Compute Engine SSH).

## Proof (real GCP, then torn down)

```text
GET /v1/health                         → 200 ok
doctor --provider cloud-run-sandbox    → control_plane ready
run -- echo ok                         → exit 0 (~1.4s)
run -- node -e '…'                     → hello-from-sandbox exit 0
warmup → run --id → uname -a → stop    → 4.19.0-gvisor, lease released
```

Project/service/secrets/gcloud auth cleaned after proof.

## Use

```sh
# service must have --sandbox-launcher
export CLOUD_RUN_SANDBOX_URL=https://….run.app
export CLOUD_RUN_SANDBOX_SECRET=…
crabbox doctor --provider cloud-run-sandbox
crabbox run --provider cloud-run-sandbox -- echo ok
```

Full GCP setup: `docs/providers/cloud-run-sandbox.md`

## Verify

```sh
go test ./internal/providers/cloudrunsandbox/ ./internal/providers/all/
gofmt -l internal/providers/cloudrunsandbox
node scripts/generate-provider-matrix.mjs --check
```

## Safety

- secrets env-only (never config/argv)
- gateway URL not from repo YAML
- egress deny-by-default
- claims scoped to gateway/cli
